config.action_normalization: x0/y0/length use patch-width scaling; signed bend maps symmetrically to [0,1] around 0.5; force and angle use min-max mappings
config.notes: General refinement beyond the 900/100 paper data budget: 1800/200 real MuJoCo transitions. Half force proposals uniform in 0.4-0.65 N, half uniform over the full action range. Unchanged UNet, optimizer, loss and 1000 epochs. All 24 pigments, random geometry, no target images or target trajectories.

stage1_config.notes: Paper robot family, 18x21 inch canvas, 24 wells, short 50 mm brush and Fig. A1 mount structure. Unpublished assembly dimensions estimated locally. Axial spring brush and continuous height-feedback force servo are simulation approximations. General stability refinement: brush penalty-contact relaxation 20 ms instead of 6 ms. Original timestep, controller period, axial spring, servo and paint deposition retained. This is a local numerical contact choice, not a paper hardware parameter.
